source_meta.title: The Technology Trap: Capital, Labor, and Power in the Age of Automation
source_meta.author: Carl Benedikt Frey

record.quote_verbatim:
Overall, our algorithm predicted that 47 ­percent of American jobs are susceptible to automation,
meaning that they are potentially automatable from a technological
point of view, given the latest computer-­controlled equipment and sufficient relevant data for the algorithm to draw upon.
record.claim_summary: 47 percent of American jobs are susceptible to automation based on technological capability.
record.mechanism_text: potentially automatable from a technological point of view, given the latest computer-­controlled equipment and sufficient relevant data for the algorithm to draw upon
record.coder_notes: Author Carl Benedikt Frey is reflecting on and restating the well-known Frey & Osborne (2013/2017) finding ('our algorithm predicted...'). The horizon of 10-20 years from the original 2013 paper is not mentioned in this excerpt. Soft hyphens from OCR preserved in verbatim quote.
